# Bluetooth fixes found on hardware

## Overview
Phase 2's Bluetooth transport never worked on a real Flipper (firmware
1.5.1). Debugging on the owner's Flipper on 2026-10-26 found three causes;
a hand-patched test build with all three fixed connected the Mac app over
Bluetooth (`hello` both ways, link `connected`). This plan turns that test
build into proper, tested code.

1. **The advertisement does not fit.** The Flipper log shows
   `[E][BleGap] set_discoverable failed 146` (`BLE_STATUS_INVALID_PARAMS`,
   `ble_defs.h`). The stack adds the flags (3 bytes) and TX power (3 bytes);
   the 128-bit service UUID AD is 18 bytes; the name AD (`ble_wire_adv_name`,
   up to 8 chars) is up to 10. 34 > 31. Nothing is advertised, yet the
   Idle screen says "BLE adv": the firmware raises
   `GapEventTypeStartAdvertising` even when `aci_gap_set_discoverable`
   fails (`targets/f7/ble_glue/gap.c`, `gap_advertise_start`).
   Verified fix: no name in the advertisement.
2. **"Connected" never comes.** In SDK 1.5.1 `gap.c` raises
   `GapEventTypeConnected` only from `ACI_GAP_PAIRING_COMPLETE_VSEVT_CODE`.
   We never pair, so the Bt service never reports `BtStatusConnected`, and
   `ble_is_connected` (`flipper/src/transport_ble.c`) stays false: the
   Flipper receives the host's `hello` (64 bytes, logged) but never answers.
   Verified fix: a host is connected when it has subscribed to TX
   (`opened && subscribed`); a disconnect clears `subscribed` already.
3. **The subscription event.** The verified build set TX's `gatt_evt_mask`
   to `GATT_NOTIFY_ATTRIBUTE_WRITE` (it was `GATT_DONT_NOTIFY_EVENTS`); with
   it the CCCD write arrives as an attribute-modified event and
   `svc_subscribe(true)` runs. Keep it.

## Context (from discovery)
- Flipper: `flipper/src/ble_flibuddy_svc.c` (GAP template,
  `profile_gap_config`, characteristic params), `flipper/src/ble_wire.{c,h}`
  (`ble_wire_adv_name`, `BLE_WIRE_ADV_NAME_*`, header comment on the 31-byte
  budget), `flipper/src/transport_ble.c` (`ble_is_connected`,
  `transport_ble_status`, `bt_status_changed`), `flipper/src/screen_text.c`
  (status line "BLE adv" / "no host" / connected text),
  `flipper/tests/test_ble_wire.c`, `flipper/tests/test_screen_text.c`.
- Host: `host/Sources/FliBuddyCore/Transport/BLE/CoreBluetoothCentral.swift`
  takes the name from `peripheral.name` or the advertisement's local name;
  the scan filters on the service UUID, so the name is display only.
- Firmware reference: `~/src/flipperzero-firmware` (1.5.1):
  `targets/f7/ble_glue/gap.c` (`gap_advertise_start`, `gap_init`: the scan
  response carries `GapConfig.mfg_data` as manufacturer-specific data; the
  GAP device name is `adv_name + 1`).

## Development Approach
- **Testing approach**: TDD for everything host-testable (`ble_wire`,
  `screen_text`, app state, Swift); the SDK-bound files are checked by the
  FAP build and on hardware.
- Complete each task fully before moving to the next; all tests must pass.
- **CRITICAL: update this plan file when scope changes during implementation.**

## Progress Tracking
- Mark completed items with `[x]` immediately when done
- Add newly discovered tasks with ➕ prefix; blockers with ⚠️

## Implementation Steps

### Task 1: Advertise within 31 bytes, name in the scan response
- [x] tests first in `flipper/tests/test_ble_wire.c`: a new
      `ble_wire_adv_size(name_len)`/budget helper or equivalent proves the
      advertisement (flags 3 + TX power 3 + 128-bit UUID 18, no name) fits
      31 bytes, and that the scan-response manufacturer data
      (`0xFF 0xFF` test company id + the Flipper's name, up to the space
      the scan response allows) is built correctly, with the "Flipper"
      fallback for an unnamed Flipper
- [x] `ble_flibuddy_svc.c`: the advertisement carries no local name
      (the advertised name AD is empty) while the GAP device name stays the
      Flipper's name if the SDK allows it; if `gap.c` derives both from
      `adv_name`, keep the GAP name empty and carry the name only in
      `GapConfig.mfg_data` (scan response); document the choice in the
      `ble_wire.h` header comment with the byte budget
- [x] host: `CoreBluetoothCentral` reads the name from the manufacturer
      data (company id `0xFFFF`) when `peripheral.name` and the local name
      are missing; unit-test the parser in `FliBuddyCore` (pure function)
- [x] run `make -C flipper/tests test`, `cd flipper && ufbt`,
      `cd host && swift test` - must pass before task 2

### Task 2: A subscribed host is a connected host
- [x] `transport_ble.c`: `ble_is_connected` is `opened && subscribed`;
      comment why (SDK 1.5.1 raises Connected only after pairing)
- [x] `transport_ble_status`: `TransportBleConnected` when subscribed,
      `TransportBleAdvertising` when the Bt status says advertising and no
      host is subscribed, else off; move the decision into a host-testable
      pure function (e.g. in `ble_wire` or `app_state`) and test the table
- [x] TX characteristic: `gatt_evt_mask = GATT_NOTIFY_ATTRIBUTE_WRITE`
      with a comment that the CCCD write must reach `on_event`
- [x] tests for the status table and for `screen_text` showing the
      connected text over Bluetooth
- [x] run `make -C flipper/tests test` and `cd flipper && ufbt` - must pass

### Task 3: Verify acceptance criteria
- [x] `make test`, `make lint`, `make coverage`, `cd flipper && ufbt`
- [x] the advertisement budget is asserted in a test, not only in a comment
      (`test_ble_wire.c`: `ble_wire_adv_size`, `ble_wire_scan_response_size`
      against `BLE_WIRE_ADV_MAX`)

### Task 4: Documentation
- [x] `flipper/README.md` and `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-flipper-spoolbuddy-design.md`
      (Phase 2 section): the three hardware findings and the fixes; note
      that "BLE adv" on the Flipper is shown even if advertising fails at
